summary: Teacher advocates for preserving E-Rate to ensure schools can maintain essential internet access for students.

claims.argument: Reducing or eliminating E-Rate funding could place additional costs on schools, potentially diverting resources from educational resources and opportunities.
claims.evidence_quote: If E-Rate funding were reduced or eliminated, our schools and district could face additional costs simply to maintain the reliable connectivity our students and teachers depend upon. Those additional costs could place pressure on already limited educational resources and potentially affect our ability to provide students with the technology and digital learning opportunities they need.
